story.title: Our Story
story.intro: Our journey from a volunteer team to a comprehensive marketing agency
story.content: "Marketing in Arabic" started as a passionate volunteer team, driven by a genuine desire to change the concept of marketing in the Syrian market, and present it in an understandable Arabic language close to people. The team included a group of specialized trainers in various fields of marketing, and we were joined by many young volunteers who found in "Marketing in Arabic" a place to learn, apply, and move towards real career opportunities. We believed that knowledge should be shared, and opportunities should be given. Therefore, we did not only focus on training, but also worked hard to empower trainees and help them enter the job market. Over time, and after a short pause, we returned with greater motivation and stronger belief in our mission. Today, "Marketing in Arabic" has evolved into a professional marketing agency, including graduates of this journey, who have become professionals providing high-quality services with the same team spirit and the same initial passion. We still carry our slogan: "We inspire, teach, and empower" but now we add a new promise to it that we provide real results, not just beautiful ideas.
